categories.title: Campsite
categories.info: If you have a Camping Kit, you may rest at Campsites for the same benefits as an Inn. Be careful; if you get attacked, you will lose the Camping Kit. Clear the surroundings before camping to prevent this.

categories.title: Dungeon
categories.info: Dungeons often house many valuables and items, but are guarded by enemies and bosses.

categories.title: Portcrystal
categories.info: Use a Ferrystone to teleport to any discovered Portcrystal

categories.title: Settlement
categories.info: Settlements are safe zones, often containing shops, inns, riftstones and quests.

categories.title: Waypoint
categories.info: Waypoints are points of interest and/or landmarks on the in-game map.

categories.title: Apothecary
categories.info: Shops sells a variety of weapons, armor and consumables.

categories.title: Armory
categories.info: Armories come in two varieties; Armor and Weapons.

categories.title: Forgotten Riftstone
categories.info: Forgotten Riftstones are scattered through the land. Activating them will either restore them (granting their unique summoning pool to the Grand Rift of Vernworth) or destroy them (summoning a high-level pawn that can be hired for free).

categories.title: Inn
categories.info: Inns allow the player to rest, replenishing their group's Health to its maximum value. Players may also spend Devotion to upgrade their skills or change their Vocation.

categories.title: Ox Station
categories.info: Ox Carts allow the player to fast travel between different location. However, this is not completely safe, and the player may be attacked during them.

categories.title: Peddler
categories.info: Peddlers are NPCs with a limited selection of wares. Offering them gifts lowers their prices.

categories.title: Riftstone
categories.info: Riftstones allow the player to summon Support Pawns.

categories.title: Vocation Guild
categories.info: Vocation Guilds are where you can manage your Voca5tions. In most settlements, this is done by the innkeeper.

categories.title: Golden Beetle
categories.info: Golden Trove Beetles permanantly increase your (or your main pawn's) carrying capacity by 0.15 kg.

categories.title: Seeker's Token
categories.info: If Seeker's Tokens are not appearing, try restarting the game from the title screen.

categories.title: Wakestone Shard
categories.info: Gathering 3 Wakestone Shards will combine into a Wakestone, which allows you to revive any dead character, including yourself.

categories.title: Armor
categories.info: Armor increases a character's defenses and resistences. There are 3 types of armor; Head, Body and Leg.

categories.title: Ring
categories.info: Rings grant special effects or resistences to their wielder. A character may wield up to 2 rings at a time.

categories.title: Chest
categories.info: Chests contain a variety of items, consumables and valuables.

categories.title: Curative
categories.info: Curative items are used to restore the player, for example replenishing Health and Stamina or removing debilitations. They may often be combined in stronger curative items.

categories.title: Loot Pile
categories.info: Loot Piles provide a random assortment of materials and valuables, depending on its kind.

categories.title: Material
categories.info: Materials are used in upgrading or enhancing equipment.

categories.title: Valuable
categories.info: Valuables are items meant to be sold or traded.

categories.title: Main Quest
categories.info: Main Quests progress the game's storyline.

categories.title: Side Quest
categories.info: Side Quests are given by NPCs once their triggers conditions have been met. They are not mandatory for story progression, although some are time-sensitive and may automatically fail if not completed quickly enough.

categories.title: Boss
categories.info: Bosses are large enemies with an overhead Health bar. They often have multiple bars, and require precise strategies or group compositions to defeat.

categories.title: Door
categories.info: Locked Doors may be opened with Keys, but can also have other requirements, such as time of day or quest completions.

4. Speak with [Gregor](#loc=328507).

locations.title: Monster Culling
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Ask Captain Brant to "tell you of Monster Cullings" during [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956)  
**Steps:**
1. Deal with the Monster Threats. Clear the following areas/encounters:
    - [Trevo Mine](#loc=328961), also go in the area behind the [Door](#loc=328985)
    - [Stormwind Cave](#loc=329050)
    - [Goblin x6](#loc=329080)
2. Report to [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- [The Stolen Throne](#loc=328960), after completing both [Disa's Plot](#loc=328958) and [The Caged Magistrate](#loc=328959)
- [The Nameless Village](#loc=355046)

media.title: Dragons Dogma 2 Gameplay Walkthrough Monster Culling

locations.title: Disa's Plot
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Ask Captain Brant to "tell you of the queen regent" during [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956)    
**Steps:**
1. Search for evidence of Disa's misdeeds.
    - During nighttime, head to [Vernworth's Castle](#loc=329087). A guard will escort you, without your pawns, to [The Guardhouse](#loc=329088).
    - There, grab the set of armor ([Marcher's Helm](#loc=329089), [Marcher's Armor](#loc=329090) and [Marcher's Cuisses](#loc=329091)) to pass as a guard. Equip it.
    - Grab the [Torn Letter](#loc=329107)
2. Report back to [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- [The Stolen Throne](#loc=328960), once [Monster Cullings](#loc=328957) and [The Caged Magistrate](#loc=328959) have been completed.
- [An Unsettling Encounter](#loc=355042)

media.title: Dragons Dogma 2 Gameplay Walkthrough Disas Plot

locations.title: The Caged Magistrate
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Ask Captain Brant to "tell you of the magistrate" during [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956)      
**Steps:**
1. Meet with [Magister Waldhar](#loc=329110) (go through the [Vernworth Castle Gaol Tower Door](#loc=329108))
2. Find a place with plenty of tomes (complete [The Heel of History](#loc=329113))
3. Tell Waldhar of the Archive of the Vaults
4. Lead Waldhar out of the Dungeon
5. Report back to [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- [The Stolen Throne](#loc=328960), after completing [Monster Cullings](#loc=328957) and [Disa's Plot](#loc=328958)

media.title: Dragons Dogma 2 Gameplay Walkthrough The Caged Magistrate

locations.title: The Stolen Throne
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Ask Captain Brant to "tell you of the masquarade" during [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956)  
**Steps:**
1. Enter the [Vernworth Hall](#loc=329092) at night time - Requires the Eventide Mask (given by Brant), [Courtly Tunic](#loc=329962) and [Courtly Breeches](#loc=329964).
2. Approach the False Sovran - Follow him through the hall.
2. Report to [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- ??

locations.title: An Unsettling Encounter
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Ask Captain Brant to "tell you of Rumors of Allard" during [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956). after completing [Disa's Plot](#loc=328958)  
**Steps:**
1. Search [Allard's Chambers](#loc=355043) - Requires the [Marcher's Armor Set](#loc=332846) to move freely around the palace at night.
2. Report to [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- ??

locations.title: The Arisen's Shadow
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete a few subquests of [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956)  
**Steps:**
1. Contend with your persuer - Once the quest is added to your log, look around for a man in brown clothes following you. Chase him down and Grab him.
2. Speak with [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- ??

locations.title: The Nameless Village
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Ask Captain Brant to "tell you of the false Sovran" during [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956), after completing [Monster Culling](#loc=328957)  
**Steps:**
1. Explore the [Nameless Village](#loc=331480)
2. Enter the [Nameless Village Depths](#loc=330639)
3. Speak with [Srail](#loc=355048) to retrieve Darragh's Bill of Arrest
4. Report to [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)

**Next Quest(s):**
- ??

locations.title: Feast of Deception
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [An Unsettling Encounter](#loc=355042)  
**Steps:**
1. Dress formally (wear the [Courtly Tunic](#loc=329962) and [Courtly Breeches](#loc=329964)) and speak with [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)
2. Await Captain Brant's plan of action (wait a few day/night cycles)

locations.title: Flickering Shadows
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [Nation of the Lambent Flame](#loc=355050)  
**Steps:**
1. Enter [Bakbattahl](#loc=331245)
2. Speak with [Ambrosius](#loc=355052) - Hand him a Small Blue Crystal Shard from the nearby shore.
3. Seek information about larger blue crystals - Speak with [The Dragonforged](#loc=355053)
4. Seek the oracle - Speak with Luz at [Reverent Shrine](#loc=330390)
4. Seek "he who has dragon forged" in [Harve Village](#loc=329037) - Speak with the Rivage Elder at [Rivage Elder's Home](#loc=331587)

**Next Quest(s):**
- [Convergence](#loc=355054)

locations.title: Convergence
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [Flickering Shadows](#loc=355051)  
**Steps:**
1. Explore the [Seafloor Shrine](#loc=331505) - Go through [Stormwind Cave](#loc=329050), through the now unlocked [Locked Door](#loc=355055)
2. Speak with [Rothais](#loc=355056)

**Next Quest(s):**
- [A New Godsway](#loc=355057)

locations.title: A New Godsway
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [Convergence](#loc=355054)  
**Steps:**
1. Deliver the godsbane to Ambrosius - He is now in the [Laboratorium - Workshop #1](#loc=331361) of the [Forbidden Magick Research Lab](#loc=330372)
2. Obtain 15 Wyrmslife Crystals - Should you be missing some, slaying the Drake in the [Dragonsbreath Tower](#loc=331493) yields 10 crystals.
3. Await the new godsway - Wait for a day/night cycle

**Next Quest(s):**
- [The Guardian Gigantus](#loc=355058) (optional)
- [Legacy](#loc=355059)

locations.title: The Guardian Gigantus
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [A New Godsway](#loc=355057)  
**Steps:**
1. Take the Godsbane to Phaesus - He is just outside the [Flamebearer Palace Spellseal Door](#loc=345128)
2. Defeat the Gigantus beyond those doors

**Next Quest(s):**
- [Legacy](#loc=355059)

**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [A Scholarly Pursuit](#loc=355061)  
**Steps:**
1. Lead the people of the land to the shrine - Complete all the following subquests.

**Next Quest(s):**
- [Civil Unrest](#loc=355064)
- [The Regentkin's Resolve](#loc=355065)
- [Wandering Roots](#loc=355066)
- [The Importance of Aiding Ernesto](#loc=355068)
- [Shepherd of the Pawns](#loc=355069)

locations.title: Civil Unrest
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Start [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)  
**Steps:**
1. Accept to overseer the fight in front of the [Bakbattahl Vocation Guild](#loc=330450)
2.  Offer food to one of the children in front of the [Pilgrim's Inn - Flagship](#loc=330453)
3.  Fight with the civilian in front of  [Whitney](#loc=345796)
4. Speak with the Emperess in the [Flamebearer Palace Prayer Hall](#loc=341797)

**Next Quest(s):**
- Other subquests; see [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)

locations.title: The Regentkin's Resolve
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Start [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)  
**Steps:**
1. Speak with [Captain Brant](#loc=328955)
2. Speak with Sven, in [Sven's Chambers](#loc=333369)
3. Intimidate the man at [West Vernworth Oxcart Station](#loc=328473)
4. Head to Disa's Room, two rooms north of Sven's. Grab Disa and bring her to Sven.

**Next Quest(s):**
- ??

locations.title: Wandering Roots
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Start [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)  
**Steps:**
1. Obtain the Arborheart Cutting from Taliesin
2. Examine the [Fertile Soil](#loc=355067)
3. Report back to Taliesin

**Next Quest(s):**
- Other subquests; see [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)

locations.title: The Importance of Aiding Ernesto
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Start [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)  
**Steps:**
1. Head to [Windwalker's Home](#loc=332254).
2. Bring back Gautstafr and Cliodhna; you will have to carry Gatustafr back

**Next Quest(s):**
- Other subquests; see [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)

locations.title: Shepherd of the Pawns
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Start [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)  
**Steps:**
1. Follow Henrique to the pawns
2. Grab the [Diminished Godsway](#loc=355070)
3. Return to Henrique

**Next Quest(s):**
- Other subquests; see [Halls of the First Dawn](#loc=355063)

locations.title: The Provisioner's Plight
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach [Geoffroy](#loc=327825) after completing [Tale's Beginning](#loc=327804)  
**Steps:**
1. Deliver the provisioner's note to [Markus](#loc=327822).
2. Procure some harspuds and salubrious draughts.
    - Some harspuds may be found [here](#loc=327824). Salubrious Draughts are made by combining fruits (such as [strawberries](#loc=327823)) with a greenwarish, a common herb found on the sides of roads.
3. Give Markus the provisions.
4. Report back to Geoffroy

**Reward(s):**
- Waking Powder x1
- 900G
- Dried Fruit x1
- Some (?) XP

locations.title: Ordeals of a New Recruit
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach [Phill](#loc=327828) after completing [Tale's Beginning](#loc=327804)  
**Time Sensitive?:** Yes  
**Steps:**
1. Aid [Accardo](#loc=327830) (Defeat the [Harpies](#loc=327829))

**Reward(s):**
- 400 XP
- 1,000G
- Lantern Oil

locations.title: Medicament Predicament
locations.description:

locations.title: A Beggar's Tale
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Witness [Albert](#loc=328912) preaching during the day.  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Keep an eye on the beggar. Follow him until nightfall to[ this location](#loc=328922).
2. Obtain the [Beggar's Garb](#loc=328925); you might need to wait a little before being able to enter the house.
3. Deliver the Begger's Garb to either Albert (who will be in front of his house the following morning), [Celina](#loc=328932) or [Hilda](#loc=328930).

**Reward(s):**
- 900 XP
- If given to Albert: 5,000G
- If given to Hilda: 3x Onyx
- If given to Celina: 3,000 G, 1x Noonbloom. Go to Albert's house the next day to receive the rewards.

locations.title: Claw Them Into Shape
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with [Beren](#loc=328948)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Find Beren [a motivated soldier to train](#loc=330649).
2. Procure three swords for Beren
    - You may purchase these at any weapon's armory, such as [Roderick's Smithy](#loc=328464)
3. Have a bout with Beren
4. Follow Beren (to the [campsite](#loc=328406))

**Reward(s):**
- 1,200 XP
- 4,500 G

locations.title: The Heel of History
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Donate 1,000 G and any Food item to [Kendrick](#loc=329112)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Determine Malcolm's location (speak with [Aimee](#loc=329115), [Rick](#loc=329117) and [Harvey](#loc=329116))
2. Report back to Kendrick
3. Search the Vaults for Malcolm
4. Follow Malcolm

**Reward(s):**
- 3,000 G

locations.title: Tolled to Rest
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Enter area

**Time Sensitive?:** No

**Steps:**
1.  Save Oskar from enemy attacks
2. Escord into Ancient Battleground

**Reward(s):**
-  Ancient Battleground Key

locations.title: Oxcart Courier
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach [Donovan](#loc=330427)  
**Time Sensitive?:** Yes  
**Steps:**
1. Make for Melve and deliver the letter to Lennart.
2. Report back to Donovan.

**Reward(s):**
- 300 Experience

- Miner's Hosen

locations.title: Nesting Troubles
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach Lennart  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1.  Throw explosive casks into the saurian nest.
2. Report back to Lennart.
3. Throw a jar of poison into the saurian nest.
4. Report back to Lennart.

**Reward(s):**
- 300 Experience
- 1250 G
- Stoutness Extract

locations.title: Scaly Invaders
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Walk into [Harve Village](#loc=329037)
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Defeat the saurians.
2. Report back to Fyoran.
3. Wait a few days, then return to Harve Village.

**Reward(s):**
- ??

locations.title: Spellbound
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Trysha will only give you the quest if her grandma is not in the same room or house.   

**Time Sensitive?:** No  

**Steps:**  
1. Find grimoires for Trysha
   1. Let there be Light
   2. Fulminous Shield
   3. Nation's Death Knell
   4. Howling Blizzard
   5. Towering Earth

**Reward(s):**
- Turquoise Ring

locations.title: Beren's Final Lesson
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Completed [Claw Them Into Shape](#loc=328951)   
**Time Sensitive?:** Yes  
**Steps:**
1. Kill attacking Cyclops

**Reward(s):**
- Lifetaker

locations.description:

locations.title: Saint of the Slums
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Witness the conversation between the Abbess Elena and the beastren parents.

**Time Sensitive?:** No 

**Steps**
1. Talk to Elena
2. Bring her three Miasmite
3. Follow her tour of Gracious Hand
4. Speak to Lubomir
5. Gather evidence

**Reward**: ??

locations.title: The Gift of Giving
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to Daphne  
**Time Sensitive?:** No   
**Steps:**  
1. Speak to Daphne
2. Bring her Bunch of Flowers
3. Bring her a Silver Ore
4. Wait for a few days for the next request. Her request will be two pieces of Gold Ore
5. Her final request is five medicines that can cure blightness  

**Reward(s):**  
- 100 G
- [Golden Trove Beetle](#loc=332189)

locations.title: House of the Blue Sunbright
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to **Diana**  
**Prerequisite:** Complete '**[The Gift of Giving](#loc=332187)**'  
**Time Sensitive?:** No
  
_Note: This quest has multiple outcomes!_
    
**Steps:**
1. Visit **Townsend's Estate** in the Noble Quarter
2. Find Sebastian's look-like ( Daphne )
3. Escort Daphne back to the manor
4. Help Sebastian prepare | x1 Detoxifying Decoction | x1 Waking Powder | Cyclops item drop ( Mishapen eye, rugged bone ) 
   1. *Failing to help Sebastian will result in a different outcome*
5. Wait a day or so and return to the manor.

**Reward(s):**
-  **(If you helped Sebastian prepare)**
- 900 XP
- x2 Fine Harspud Roborant
- 3000 G

locations.title: Put a Spring in Thy Step
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach Gautstafr  
**Time Sensitive?:** Mo   
**Steps:**
1.  Give 3 Wild Flowers to him.
2. Guide him to his house.
3. Talk to him about helping guide him to the springs.
4. Guide him to the springs. Warning: Cyclops enroute.

**Reward(s):**
- Unlocks the Magick Archer Vocation

media.title: Dragons Dogma 2 How To Unlock Magick Archer

locations.title: Prey for the Pack
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to Morris   
**Time Sensitive?:** Yes    
**Steps:**
1. Speak to Morris, he will ask you to search his lost grandson, [Rodge](#loc=329513)  
2. Ask to townfolk about [Rodge](#loc=329513)  
3.Follow the trail made of Moonglow
4. Save [Rodge](#loc=329513) from the wolves inside the [Putrid Cave](#loc=329510)
5. Escort [Rodge](#loc=329513) back to his grandfather Morris.

**Reward(s):**
- 11000 G
- x2 Miracle Roborant

_NOTE: You may also go straight to the Putrid Cave to save Rodge and start the quest._

locations.title: Masked Correspondence
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:**  Start the mission "The Stolen Throne" https://mapgenie.io/dragons-dogma-2/maps/world?locationIds=328960  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Visit Sven in his room in the castle
2. Deliver the letter to ser Patrick 
3. Speak with Sven

**Reward(s):**
- Onyx
- 6,000 G

locations.title: The Ailing Arborheart
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** After a Trial of Archery Quest.

**Steps:**

2. Ask a [Blacksmith of Batthal](#loc=355411) about procuring scalecinder.

**Reward(s):**
-  None

locations.title: A Trial of Archery
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to Glyndwr  
**Prerequisite:** Complete the quest ''[Gift of the Bow](#loc=332184)'' is necessary  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1.  Speak to Glyndwr and meet him near Sacred Arbor
2. Learn about Doireann's abduction
3. Go to Ancestral Chamber and save her
4. Carry her outside

**Reward(s):**
- 16,000 G
- Portcrystal
- Repeller Bow

locations.title: Trouble on the Cape
locations.description:
**Trigger Condition:** Witness the arguement between Ulrika and Jonas

**Prerequisite:** Completing the quest [Scaly Invaders](#loc=331581) is necessary and the quest ''Readvent of Calamity'' must be in progress

**Time Sensitive:** Yes

**Steps:**

1. Go to Stormwind Cave with others
2. Rescue the villager
3. Go back to Jonas

**Reward(s):**
- 6500 G
- x1 Ferrystone

locations.title: Readvent of Calamity
locations.description:
**Trigger Condition:** Fight with the dragon attacking Melve

**Time Sensitive:** No

**Steps:**
1. Fight with the dragon
2. Speak to Ulrika
3. Visit Melve from time to time
4. Find where Ulrika fled
5. Report to Lennart

**Reward(s):**
- 4500 G
- Ring of Grit

locations.title: Till Death Do Us Part
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** To unlock this quest, players must first hear the rumor about Ser Ludolph and then speak to Margit

**Time Sensitive?:** Yes 

**Steps:**
1. Speak to Margit
2. Aid Gregor at the Illdoers' Resting Place
3. Report back to Margit

**Reward(s):**
-  5000 G
- Steeled Virtue
- Lustrous Targe **(Depending on the outcome)**

locations.title: Home Is Where The Hearth Is
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to the guard by the entrance of the village  

**Prerequisite:** Completing the quest ''Readvent of Calamity'' is necessary

**Time Sensitive?:** No

**Steps:**
1. Speak to the guard and bribe him
2. Speak to Lennart
3. Gather swords for him
4. Fight your way out
5. Speak to Ulrika

**Reward(s):**
-  12000 G
- Ring of Reassurance
- Kiss from Ulrika

locations.title: A Case of Sculptor's Block
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to Klark at night  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Pay a visit to Fulvio, a sculptor residing in Battahl.

**Reward(s):**
- Good Ending: 4500 XP, 14000 G
- Bad Ending: 2250 XP, 7000 G

locations.title: Hunt for the Jadeite Orb
locations.description:

locations.title: The Ornate Box
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Don't buy the decorated Box by this merchant.  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1.  You hear over a conversation between Sven and the mad merchant.
2. Lend Sven 1000 Gold.
3. Meet Sven a day later at the fountain and he gives you a part of your money back. (200G).
4. Meet Sven a few days later and he gives you 300G, with the promise the next time he has the rest money.
5.  Meet Sven one more time at the same spot.

**Reward(s):**
-  4000 Gold
-  Elegant Tunic
-  Elegant Trousers

locations.title: Shadowed Prayers
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Let Ser Menella buy you a Drink at [The Rockmouse's Burrow](#loc=330458)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Meet at the palace Steps in the morning hours for prayer 
2. look around the group of people on the steps before the main chamber
3. Figure out who the assassin is and tackle him

**Reward(s):**
- ??

locations.title: The Sotted Sage
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach Lamond   

**Time Sensitive?:** No  

**Steps:**
1. Give Lamond three bottles of Newt Liqeuer

**Reward(s):**
- Warfarer Vocation

locations.title: Welcome to Battahl
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Approach Roger     
**Time Sensitive?:** No   
**Steps:**
1. Defeat the ruffians.
2. Participate in the duel.

**Reward(s):**
- 8,500 G
- Fruit Wine

locations.title: Short-Sighted Ambition
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak to Isaac at his shop    
**Time Sensitive?:** ??     
**Steps:**
1. Deliver a ripened quince
2. Find "On the Transference of Souls" from Ibrahim's Scrap Store at Checkpoint town.
3. Speak to Isaac's wife and daughter
4. Either give Isaac the real book or a forgery.

**Reward(s):**
- ??

locations.title: A Place to Call Home
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with Mildred  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Speak with Mildred at [her house](#loc=330432).
2. Speak with Mildred after 1 week of in-game time.

**Reward(s):**
- A personal home (for 20,000 P)

locations.title: A Magisterial Amenity
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete both [The Caged Magistrate](#loc=328959) and [The Heel of History](#loc=329113), then wait a few days.  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Speak with [Waldhar (Vault)](#loc=355405)
2. Grab the [Exquisite Spectacles](#loc=355407) (requires [Courtly Tunic](#loc=329962) and [Courtly Breeches](#loc=329964) to enter the building).
3. Return to Waldhar

**Reward(s):**
- Winter's Path

locations.title: Every Rose Has Its Thorns
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [An Unsettling Encounter](#loc=355042)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Head to the top floor and speak with Wilhelmina.
2. Raise Wilhelmina's affinity (through gifts)
3.  Leave and return the next day
4. Investigate Allard:
    - Speak with [Captain Brant](#loc=328955), then grab the [Bribery Investigation Findings](#loc=355409)
    - Speak with Sven in [Sven's Chambers](#loc=333369), then with Patrick at [Patrick's Estate](#loc=328495). Finally, enter [Allard's Estate](#loc=328496) and grab the [Murder Report](#loc=355410)
5. Bring both documents back to Wilhelmina.

**Reward(s):**
- 8,500 G
- Ring of Benevolence

locations.title: Out of the Forest, Into the Forge
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [The Ailing Arborheart](#loc=332325)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Return to Doireann at the [Sacred Arbor](#loc=330414).
2. Bring her a rotten apple and shorefish.
3. Return to Sara at [Brokkr's Smithy](#loc=355411)
4. Follow Sara to [Stragglers' Cave](#loc=329509), then gather 5 Scalecinder while Brokkr eats.
5. Hand the Scalecinder to Doireann

**Reward(s):**
- 13,000 G

locations.title: The Sorcerer's Appraisal
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Enter [Myrddin's Home](#loc=335758) (requires fancy clothes_  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Bring him 3 of the following tomes:
    - [Let There Be Light](#loc=355414)
    - [Towering Earth](#loc=355415)
    - [Fulminous Shield](#loc=355416)
    - [Howling Blizzard](#loc=355417)
    - [Nation's Death Knell](#loc=329794) (also found here: [Nation's Death Knell](#loc=355418))


**Reward(s):**
- 11,000 G

locations.title: Mercy Among Thieves
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with [Lyssandro](#loc=355419)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Follow the road to the [Bandit](#loc=355421)
2. Follow the bandit to the [Coral Snakes' Hideout](#loc=331500)
3. Explore the hideout, following the markers.

**Reward(s):**
- 8,000 G

locations.title: A Poisonous Proposal
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with Jarle in his house.  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Get poisoned by an Asp, then come back to Jarle.
2. Get poisoned by a Venin Harpy, then come back to Jarle.
3. Meet [Jarle](#loc=355423) and challenge the [Chimera](#loc=330367). During the battle, try to make Jarle poisoned by making the Chimera face away from him.

**Reward(s):**
- 19,000 G (only 11,000 G if the Chimera is killed before Jarle is poisoned)

locations.title: Twixt a Rock and a Hard Place
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with [Akakios](#loc=355424) after completing [Nation of the Lambent Flame](#loc=355050)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Deliver the letter to [Ernesto](#loc=355426)
2. Deliver the following letter to [Barbas](#loc=355427)

**Reward(s):**
- 20,000 G

locations.title: A Candle in the Storm
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with [Menella](#loc=355428) after completing [Shadowed Prayers](#loc=341740)  
**Time Sensitive?:** No  
**Steps:**
1. Speak with the assassin in [Bakbattahl Gaol](#loc=331365), then return to Menella.
2. Speak with [Ashe](#loc=355429), then return to [Menella in Bakbattahl](#loc=355430)
3. Follow Menella, and decide to follow or oppose the plan.

**Reward(s):**
- 25,000 G (if followed) or 19,000 G (if opposed)

locations.title: Steeled Resolve, Blazing Forge
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Finish the side quest Dulled Steel, Cold Forge
**Time Sensitive?:** No   
**Steps:**
1. Speak with Sara.
2. Return to the smithy the next day.
3. Find Sara in the Mountain Base Cave.
4. Return to the Mountain Base Cave entrance before the hammer cools off.
5. Return to Brokkr's Smithy in Bakbattahl.
6. Deliver the regalia sword to Rowan in Vernworth Castle.

**Reward(s):**
- 35,000 Gold

locations.title: Off the Pilfered Path
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Speak with a guard named Benjamin after completing the side quest Tolled to Rest    
**Time Sensitive?:** No   
**Steps:**
1. Visit the Bakbattahl Gaol.
2. Speak with Hugo.
3. Speak with Brefft.
4. Either tell Hugo the truth or don't.

**Reward(s):**
- 7,000 Gold
- If the quest ends with the good ending:
   - [Frosted Edges](#loc=356240)
   - White-Leather Kerchief

locations.title: Dulled Steel, Cold Forge
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** After completing [Seat of the Sovran](#loc=328956), approach Vernworth Castle and you will be approached by Roman. If you aren't, speak to the guards in front of the castle's main gates.  
**Time Sensitive?:** No   
**Steps:**
1. Visit Vernworth Castle.
2. Speak with Roman.
3. Visit Brokkr's Smity in Bakbattahl.
4. Speak with Brokkr and Sara
5. Gather Glimmercoal in Digger's Ruins
6. Deliver Glimmercoal to Sara
7. Deliver Dulled Regalia Sword to Sara

**Reward(s):**
- 12,000 G

locations.title: A Noble Exchange
locations.description:
**Trigger Conditions:** Complete [The Stolen Throne](#loc=328960) / [Feast of Deception](#loc=355049), then visit the Masquerade Hall at night.
  
**Time Sensitive?:** No
  
**Steps:**
1. Equip the Courtly Breeches, Courtly Tunic, and  Eventide Mask provided by Captain Brant.
2. Enter the Vernworth Palace Hall on a night there's a masquerade (every other night)
3. Talk to the people inside until you're approached by a man that gives you a Paragon Staff
4. When it's revealed the staff was stolen, tackle the thief that give it to you.
    - But first, you can discard the staff in the north-westmost room if you want to buy it from [Ibrahim's Scrap Store](#loc=331214) later.
    - It's also possible to leave the hall while holding the staff - but you'll be sent to jail.

**Reward(s):**
- 7500 G (if the thief is arrested)
